* Interface to handle IkeSessionStateMachine events * *

This interface MUST be implemented by the IkeSessionStateMachine and will be called by the * ShimUtils. In this way ShimUtils can control the IkeSessionStateMachine to have SDK specific * behaviors in handling IkeSessionStateMachine events.

methods.name: void onNonFatalError(Exception e)
methods.comment: Called if a recoverable error is encountered

methods.comment: Called if a fatal error is encountered
